description: This file defines a TaskRunner class for managing and executing asynchronous tasks with setup and teardown phases, including timeout and signal handling, within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: TaskRunner
classes.description: Manages a sequence of tasks with setup and teardown, handling errors, timeouts, and interruptions.

classes.name: TimeoutWatcher
classes.description: Watches for timeout expiration during task execution.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a task to the task runner.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs all tasks with cleanup, returning the final status.

methods.name: runDeferCleanup
methods.description: Runs tasks with deferred cleanup, handling signals and timeouts.
